meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 Linear:你指定的那个团队里,每条 issue 评论都会触发它(无需 @提及),每个 issue 的评论线程成为独立对话,它会自动回复。
howto.when: 当 Linear 团队中的 issue 收到新评论时触发,无需 @提及。新 webhook 可能延迟 1–5 分钟。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Linear 频道集成
say.note: 它会从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册。

say.text: Linear 我用 Personal API Key,不用 OAuth 应用
say.note: OAuth 两个提示处回答 none。

say.text: 把 ENG 团队接到某个 agent,每条评论都回复
say.note: 会创建 messaging group 和 wiring。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude joins Linear: every comment on an issue in your chosen team triggers it (no @-mention), and each issue's comment thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new comment appears on an issue in the selected Linear team — no @-mention needed. New webhooks may lag 1–5 minutes.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel integration to my NanoClaw project
say_en.note: Copies the Linear adapter in and registers it.

say_en.text: Use a Personal API key for Linear, not an OAuth app
say_en.note: You'll answer none at the OAuth prompts.

say_en.text: Wire the ENG Linear team so every comment reaches an agent
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group and wiring.
